name: Blackbox Creations
description:
About This Game


Build without limits with the Black Box!

Here's a game where no two players ever wield the same builds — because your weapons are forged from your own skill combinations, tailor-made by an Artificial Intelligence that our very own Natural Intelligence built by hand.

Hewwo~ ヽ( ° ▽°)ノ Welcome to Blackbox Creations, a game made by Meshy Game Studio.

What you're looking at right now might just be the Steam page for the world's first 3D cartoon roguelite where your skills are generated in real time — come on in!

Top-down shooter, run after run!

Fight through the levels and try to survive the tension and the danger. Good luck out there (`・ω・´)

Here, no one can copy your build!

In our core skill system, the AI deeply analyzes your strategic intent, logically orchestrating hundreds of atomic mechanics in real-time. The result? Rigorous, self-consistent, and intuitive custom skills generated exclusively for you.

Punch straight through and turn the world upside down!

This once-beautiful world is now suffocating under the firm control of Embodied AI! It’s time to break out. As you fight your way through the stages, the rogue machines will constantly drop new Skills. Collect them, feed them into the Black Box, and forge your next insane build!

Drop in the Black Box, Forge Instantly!

Toss absolutely anything into the Black Box, and our AI will instantly forge a custom, one-of-a-kind skill right on the spot. Every single fusion is a surprise. Rely on your courage and wits to master this unpredictable chaos.

Every run brand new, every one unlike the last!

You never know where the next combination will take you. Hand-crafted levels plus infinite AI-generated variables — we want every session to feel fresh, out of control, and made just for you.

Crafted by Heart, Driven by Artistry

It's worth noting that, despite being an AI GAME, we still deeply value a true artisan spirit!  Almost all the art assets in our game were brought to life by our incredibly hardworking and creative artists. With the powerful assistance of Meshy.ai, they meticulously hand-tuned and designed every piece. A huge thanks to them for their immense effort!

Join our community

If you're curious about AI-native games and where the roguelite goes next, come talk it over with us!

The game is still in its experimental stage, and we'd love your feedback — ﾚ( ' v ' ;)ﾍ=З=З=З

Come build something no one has ever built before.
short_desc: This is an AI-mechanic game. Fuse skills with mechanics generated in real time—and blast your way through a machine-ruled world in this bullet-hell roguelite!
